name: widgentic-workspace
description: Widgets for agents — workspace root: public packages under packages/, sample hosts under examples/.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @widgentic/core && npm run build -w @widgentic/designer && npm run build -w @widgentic/webmcp && npm run build -w @widgentic/mcp
scripts.docs:check: tsx tools/docs-generate.ts --check && vitest run tools/docs-nav.test.ts && cd docs && ../node_modules/.bin/mint validate && ../node_modules/.bin/mint broken-links --check-anchors && ../node_modules/.bin/mint a11y --fail-on-error
